title: Department of Financial Services official postal-address conflict
issuer: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
excerpt: The annual report prints PIN 110091 for the DFS RTI postal destination, while the February 2026 appointment order and current grievance page use PIN 110001 for Jeevan Deep Building.
notes: Quarantined from all filing output. The current June 2026 appointment document must be independently inspected to resolve the designation-based RTI service address; no PIN may be guessed or silently normalized.

technical.notes: Conflicting official PIN values were compared and isolated from the usable annual-report claims.

legalRti.notes: Resolve from current primary directory evidence before postal filing support.
